extension.summary: GUI sounds for the couch console
extension.description: The living-room console's own UI sound set, curated from produced sound libraries (Google's Material Design sound resources, CC BY 4.0, and the SND kits from snd.dev) and level-matched by couch/tools/uisounds-curate. See CREDITS.txt. Change picks in data/uisounds-picks.json, never the wavs.
